study: Exploratory AP/PA case-mix standardization after prior subgroup inspection
resampling: Independently within each AP/PA x label cell; same sampled IDs across models, seeds and conditions. Fixed observed cell sizes.
standardization: Within each view, assign positive and negative labels weight 0.5. Standardized selective risk = weighted accepted errors / weighted acceptance, separately per seed, then average seeds.
contrast: PA minus AP standardized selective risk; descriptive and conditional on fixed models, cutoffs and empirical strata. Not a causal adjustment or prospective clinical risk estimate.
baseline: Descriptive view-only rule: AP predicts positive, PA predicts negative. Direction chosen after viewing label association; not independently validated.
data: Saved primary external predictions only; no raw-image download, training or new acceptance threshold. Secondary Not Normal sample excluded.
